title: A geometric rigidity estimate for codimension-1 immersions into spheres
summary: We establish a quantitative stability estimate for codimension-one immersions into a round sphere. Let $(M,g)$ be an oriented Riemannian manifold and suppose that a prescribed shape operator is realised by a smooth isometric immersion $θ:(M,g)\to\mathbb S^{n+1}$. We prove that, on every relatively compact strongly Lipschitz domain and for every $1<p<\infty$, any Sobolev immersion $φ$ is close to $θ$ modulo an ambient rotation, with the $W^{1,p}$-distances between both the immersions and their Gauss maps controlled by the $L^p$ stretching-plus-bending energies of $φ$.
